study.question: Does the direction-sensitive benefit of FP64 centered auxiliary product-context transfer depend on its component orthogonal to the instantaneous centered click context cotangent, its parallel component, or both, once a common collection topology passes replay gates?
study.hypothesis: Unverified: useful auxiliary transfer includes an orientation-sensitive component outside the instantaneous centered click context direction, rather than being explained solely by reinforcement along that direction. With C the aggregate centered auxiliary cotangent and K the occupied-row-centered click-only context cotangent, define P=proj_K(C) globally over the occupied batch/context matrix and O=C-P. Reversing O while retaining P should reduce click AUC relative to C if this orthogonal component contributes. A parallel-only reflection supplies a distinct mechanism contrast, and C/-C are topology bridges. These are interventions on surrogate backward flow, not new scalar losses or a production optimizer claim.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the whole forward model, FP64 aggregate reduction and centered auxiliary transfer. Replace the three-output auxiliary collector plus direct click edge by a shared four-output collector to observe the click reference; selectively reflect its parallel/orthogonal auxiliary components.

Prior partial-reflection receipts are the nearest local mechanism, so no novelty is claimed. Their positive replay fell from the earlier 0.6683622090 anchor to 0.6676314513, leaving the apparent partial-reflection effects unresolved. Exact r0039 source is not supplied; do not assert an exact reproduction or equivalent projection definition. This implementation specifies a global centered-click projection and FP64 reduction, with explicit endpoint bridges.

Archived exact-version primary text section 4.3 lines 250-277 verifies candidate-conditioned unnormalized local activation. That inherited forward operator is retained. The new intervention concerns training-only auxiliary product-context cotangents; this is not an exact original DIN reproduction.

study.proposed_difference: At fixed state every prediction and private-task derivative is inherited. During training a four-output identity custom autograd Function collects click/cart/fav/buy context cotangents. G=(g_cart+g_fav)+g_buy is accumulated in FP64 on occupied rows; C=G-mean_occupied(G). K is the similarly centered click-only cotangent; P=<C,K>/<K,K>*K, globally flattened over occupied rows and context coordinates, with P=0 when K=0 and max-absolute rescaling of K for numerical stability. All cells compute P,O and all reflections. The only factorial switches choose C, C-2P=-P+O, 2P-C=P-O, or -C. Native and whole-reversed endpoints bypass P+O reconstruction. The selected auxiliary matrix is cast once and added to the unmodified click cotangent in native context dtype. The training-only collector is absent during evaluation. Model source performs no filesystem/network operations.
predictions: Prerequisite: native and whole-reversed joint-collection controls reproduce the direct-click FP64 endpoints within the predefined gates. Otherwise the earlier mechanism conclusion does not transfer to this topology.

Conditional on bridge and nontrivial O-energy checks, native C should exceed P-O in validation click AUC if auxiliary direction outside K is useful. This is a causal orientation contrast in the implemented training dynamics, not proof of semantic information or parameter-space alignment.

If benefit is mainly local reinforcement along K, flipping P should be more consequential after accounting for component energy; if both directions matter, both partial reflections may hurt. No preferred result is asserted in advance.

C versus -C should retain the sign ordering observed in r0044 if the collection path is admissible. A reversal of that ordering triggers numerical/topology investigation, not a post hoc favorable interpretation.

All four cells have 32192421 total / 31793216 embedding / 399205 dense parameters; evaluation graph, masking, compute and fixed-state outputs are identical. Training has the same additional FP64 projection work in every cell; measure actual cost rather than assume equal wall time.
falsifiers: A failed fixed-state numerical/ownership check or material native/whole-reversed bridge mismatch invalidates the intended matched attribution; do not interpret partial-reflection AUCs as resolving the previous mechanism.

With non-negligible O energy, no reproducible click-AUC disadvantage for P-O against C falsifies the proposed useful orthogonal orientation effect in this setting. A null single-seed result is preliminary, not a universal mechanism refutation.

If only parallel reflection matters, evidence favors a click-direction reinforcement explanation over the proposed orthogonal contribution; if neither partial contrast is stable across admissible repetitions, retain the mechanism as unresolved.
Failure to exceed the existing click-only/control anchors reproducibly rules out a demonstrated net utility advantage for this implementation, even if component interventions alter training.
alternative_explanations: Local reduction/casting/graph scheduling rather than useful auxiliary supervision; r0039-r0041 show this is a consequential confound
Generic optimizer trajectory changes, total update magnitude, batch composition, repeated context IDs and nonlinear adaptation rather than task-specific representation information
Unequal P/O energy or nearly zero K makes an apparent component asymmetry uninformative
Broad category/brand/24h auxiliary-label semantics and inherited offline history visibility can explain transfer without advertisement-specific conversion learning
Single-seed noise, extensive validation reuse and differing calibration: r0044 native click AUC exceeded reflected AUC while reflected logloss was lower

validation_plan.phase_and_execution: Propose only: local syntax, AST, schema and source-integrity checks. No torch/tensor execution, raw-data access, training, scoring, installations or held-out assessment in the coding environment. No runtime validation CLI or tensor preflight interface is exposed here; the following are host prerequisites, not claims of executed checks.
validation_plan.starting_point: Use existing matching-protocol host receipts as the starting point; verify supplied baseline and ancestor source hashes. Raw parquet checksum/loader readiness is inherited from the frozen host contract, not independently reaudited here. No private campaign paths, credentials or runtime internals are inspected.
fixed_state_checks: On host-controlled synthetic and authorized masked inputs, use identical state_dict and host precision. Require identical outputs for all four variants and the direct-click ancestor in both train and eval modes; identical registered state, parameter names/counts, initialization and RNG after construction. Check one-forward BN counter/moment updates, no extra state mutations, and eval checkpoint round trip.

Check all-empty, one-occupied, mixed/fully occupied histories; zero click gradient, constant click gradient on occupied rows, zero/constant auxiliary gradients, large dynamic range and mutually cancelling task cotangents. Include repeated context IDs. Empty rows must get zero auxiliary transfer and retain their original click gradient.

Use explicitly prescribed output cotangents to verify the custom VJP against an independent FP64 oracle, including cotangent argument order and label-name mapping with permuted feature_map.labels. Do NOT finite-difference the identity forward as if this surrogate VJP were its derivative.

Before cast: require C=P+O, <P,O>=0, zero occupied-row component means and equal Frobenius norms for C, C-2P, 2P-C, -C within rtol=1e-10 and scale-aware atol=1e-12 times the maximum tested component norm (use exact zero checks when all zero). Verify K=0 gives P=0. After cast/add, compare to the independently cast/add oracle with rtol=1e-6 and absolute tolerance scaled to 1e-7 times max(abs(click),abs(transfer)); log rounding error separately. Do not silently loosen gates or alter the host precision.

At fixed state all private task parameter derivatives and click-only derivatives must match the ancestor with scale-aware rtol=1e-6; only the intended shared context input derivative may change. Frozen auxiliary item/scorer/tower/residual context paths must remain blocked. Compare native and reversed collector context gradients against corresponding direct-click ancestors; log sparse repeated-ID aggregation differences separately.

bridge_gate.predeclared_tolerance: After passing fixed-state gates, absolute full-validation click-AUC drift <=0.00005 for EACH endpoint; also native must remain above reversed. This is an operational admissibility tolerance, not a confidence interval or significance threshold. Log logloss, all task metrics and each history slice irrespective of pass. A failed bridge blocks transfer of r0044 interpretation; it is not repaired by choosing favorable partial-arm results.

validation_plan.mechanism_diagnostics: The exposed candidate API has no documented diagnostics callback. The split/reducer functions are directly callable by host preflight if supported. Record fixed-state and, if an authorized diagnostic interface is available, predeclared non-adaptive training probes of ||C||,||P||,||O||, projected energy fractions, <C,K>, zero-K frequency, numerical reconstruction error, before/after-cast norms, and repeated-ID scatter effects. Probe identical batches/states across arms and charge the work. Do not add loss-visible state, log from model code or consume current labels in forward. If these measurements cannot be collected, mark energy/geometry attribution unresolved rather than infer it solely from endpoint AUC.
validation_plan.evaluation: Click AUC selects on the complete fixed validation population. Report click logloss, all four task AUC/logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, parameter counts, allocated GPU/wall/train/inference time, examples processed, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. Inherit predeclared history bins (empty,1-16,17-64,>64); retain sample/positive/negative counts. New slices remain exploratory and only use host-authorized feedback. No synthetic performance or significance claim.
validation_plan.uncertainty: Current phase freezes seed 20262027. Do not masquerade replays as independent seeds. A later admissible suite should target three paired seeds and paired user-cluster bootstrap if host prediction/cluster access permits; no raw user IDs are supplied to the model. Record omissions and call single-seed effects preliminary. No holdout access until selection/comparison/commands/hashes are frozen in the authorized assessment phase.

Prior partial reflections yielded 0.6681049250/0.6677920016, but positive replay was 0.6676314513 versus 0.6683622090 for reconstructed task-direct reduction. Do not count the earlier apparent partial effects as controlled evidence; preserve this failed attribution branch.

FP32 collected task/aggregate AUC 0.6674577110/0.6674397049; both FP64 arms 0.6682972490. This local implementation sensitivity motivates inherited FP64 and new topology gates; it does not establish that the entire model is numerically invariant.

Direction matters in those single-seed implementations; reflected click logloss was lower, so AUC ordering is not a universal metric improvement. No new candidate here is measured.
